id: \bI built my house in the middle of the road. I just love the attention it brings!
en: \bI built my house in the middle of the road. I just love the attention it brings!
it: \bHo costruito casa mia in mezzo alla strada. Adoro le attenzioni che attira!

id: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \rSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rI don't understand why everyone is so excited about a little contest. I hope it goes away soon.
en: \rI don't understand why everyone is so excited about a little contest. I hope it goes away soon.
it: \rNon capisco perché siano tutti così eccitati per una garetta. Spero che finisca presto.
